syllabus_topics: Integration of design and development of technological processes
Technical capabilities of universal CAD/CAM systems
Parts, devices, and cutting tools libraries
Three- and five-coordinate machining of sculpture surfaces
assessment_rules: 70% of the final grade is based on the course assignment, and the rest (30%) depends on the student’s performance. The course assignment includes the development of a sculpture surface model, definition of cutting tools, graphical simulation and creation of a NC program for a machine tool center, documented in an explanatory report of 10 pages. Assessment type is current assessment, with a written exam.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
